Downloading Topaz Labs AI Model (.tz) Files

Topaz Labs software (such as Topaz Photo AI, Video AI, Gigapixel AI, and DeNoise AI) uses proprietary AI model files, typically with the .tz or .tz2 extension. These files are required for the software's AIpowered features and are normally downloaded automatically as needed. However, users often seek direct links for offline or batch downloading.

 Direct Links to Topaz Labs AI Model Files

Several resources provide lists of direct download links for Topaz Labs .tz AI model files:

 GitHub and Gist Lists:  
   A frequently updated  contains a comprehensive list of model file URLs for Topaz Gigapixel AI, DeNoise AI, and other products. You can download the entire list as a text file and use a batch downloader (like aria2c) to fetch all models at once. Place the downloaded .tz files in the appropriate directory (e.g., %AppData%\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel AI\tgrc\ or %PROGRAMDATA%\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel AI\tgrc\) to avoid repeated inapp downloads[5].

 Community Tutorials and Examples:  
   The Topaz Labs Community forums provide tutorials and examples of model URLs, such as:
    
    
    
    
    Users recommend building a list of all needed files and using a batch downloader like JDownloader[2].

 GitHub Model Collections:  
   Some GitHub repositories, like , curate lists of model file links for Topaz Photo AI and other products. These repositories often include hundreds of direct URLs to .tz and .tz2 files for various model versions and resolutions[6].

 How to Use the Links

1. Download the Files:  
   Use a batch downloader (e.g., aria2c, JDownloader) with the provided list of URLs to download the .tz files.

2. Place in Correct Folder:  
   Move the downloaded files to the appropriate directory for your Topaz product. Common locations include:
    %AppData%\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel AI\tgrc\
    %PROGRAMDATA%\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel AI\tgrc\
    For Video AI: C:\ProgramData\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Video AI\models\[5][2].

3. Backup Your Models:  
   New installations or updates may overwrite the models folder, so keep a backup to avoid repeated downloads[2].

 Example Model File Links

Here are a few sample direct links (from public sources):

 http://veai-models.topazlabs.com/alq-v10-gnet-fp16-576x384-1x-ox.tz  
 http://models.topazlabs.com/v1/ggi-v1-fp16-256x256-2x-ox.tz  
 https://models-bal.topazlabs.com/v1/claa-v1-fp32-512x512-ox.tz[2][5][6]

For a full list, refer to the GitHub Gist or repository above.

 Important Notes

 Legitimacy: Only download model files from official Topaz Labs servers or trusted community sources to avoid malware.
 Updates: Topaz Labs may update model file URLs or naming conventions over time. Always check for the latest lists if you encounter missing models.
 Manual Download Use Case: Offline downloads are helpful if you have slow or unreliable internet, or want to preload all models for faster software use[2][5][6].



In summary:  
You can find and download Topaz Labs AI model .tz files using curated URL lists from community forums, GitHub repositories, and Gists. Use a batch downloader to fetch the files and place them in the correct directory for your Topaz product[2][5][6].
